To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the combined use of a genetically encoded marker with laser-micro-dissection enables cell type-specific gene expression profiling of the adult brain and that cell type-restricted transcriptome analysis is mandatory to reveal cell type-specific molecular signatures in the brain.
the use of a genetic tag in combination with laser-micro dissection is the only way to obtain cell-type specific gene expression profiles in the CNS.
the combined use of a cell type-specific genetic marker and laser-microdissected samples allows for unbiased transcriptome profiling of practically any cell type in the brain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the transcriptome of the adult mouse brain with a special focus on the neocortex and the cerebellum.

the molecular mechanisms of the brain, which is a major obstacle of gene expression profiling of the brain, because physiologic relevant changes of transcription of a specific neuron is lost in the presence other neurons and glial cells.
the analysis of gene expression patterns in genetically defined neurons and neuronal subpopulations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is a very interesting study that has the potential to be a major breakthrough in the field of gene expression profiling of the brain.
cellularly complex samples, e.g., cortical layers and microregions, lead to averaged gene expressions that lack substantial amounts cell type-specific information.
cellularly complex CNS targets lead to averaged global gene expression profiles that do not contain substantial amounts of cell specific information.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method to analyze the transcriptome of single cells in the brain.
we developed a new technology that allows us to look into the brain and see what the genes of a certain cell type do.
the combination of a genetically defined cell type and microdissection is a powerful strategy to identify cell type-specific genes and to analyze their function in the brain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the genetic identity of a neuron is a major determinant of its transcriptome.
cell type-specific sampling is essential for the unbiased detection of gene expression changes in the brain.
cell type-restricted transcriptome analyses are essential for the discovery of cell type-specific molecular signatures in complex tissues like the brain.
